fixer.title: chat: pick cloud sandbox repository fixes

introducer.title: chat: allow cloud sandbox creation from the editor window

cases.mechanism: The old contribution entered an extension-backed picker whose repository callback ignored `RepositoryPicker`'s request cancellation token; after each 300 ms pause, a new extension-host command and GitHub request could start while superseded searches continued.
cases.symptom: Typing successive repository terms could leave stale GitHub searches running concurrently, consuming API/network capacity and delaying the latest interactive result.
cases.fixedBehavior: The new callback creates a request AbortController, aborts it when the shared picker cancels a superseded request, and passes the combined signal through `_searchRepositories` to the GitHub transport, which removes/cancels requests with no remaining waiter.
cases.evidence: Base line 300 called `github.copilot.chat.cloudSessions.openRepository`; that extension invoked `_chat.pickRepository`, whose command callback accepted only `query` and executed the extension search command without forwarding the request token. Added lines 58-61 now connect `requestToken.onCancellationRequested` to an AbortController and pass its signal into all repository REST/query calls. The shared picker clears the prior request token on every value change and before each update.
